title: Opaque 40-character GitHub App installation token
summary: A synthetic ghs_ token of the opaque form: the prefix and 36 base62 characters (40 in total) with no dots, in a bare form and in env, JSON and CRLF carriers.
rationale: The opaque form is still issued to installations the rollout has not reached and still valid for tokens issued earlier. A matcher updated only for the JWT form must keep the 40-character form; one that requires a dot must not.

expectation.rationale: Flagged. The provider describes the earlier form as 40 characters with no dots and recommends an expression that covers it; the 36-character body also matches contract revision 1.

sources.supports: ghs_APPID_JWT notation; about 520 characters; applications relying on exactly 40 characters may break.
Stateful token is a short opaque string with no dots.
Staged rollout of ghs_APPID_JWT and the warning about relying on exactly 40 characters.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
